title: Mary as God’s cellarer and neck of the body—Salazar: other Saints’ influx only as moon mediating
source_text: LXX. Propterea Bernardinus ille de Bustis saepius nominatus, dicit Deum fecisse Virginem Cellariam suam: quia in tantum eam Deus dilexit, ut nihil nos habere voluerit, quod per manus ejus non transiret. Unde est quod Alexis de Salo dicit Virginem Mariam esse collum, per quod servator noster qui caput est, in Ecclesiam influit omnem motum & sensum spiritualem; esse truncum per quem radix vitam ramis suppeditat, & flores, fructus, ac folia producit. Et pelvim quae abundantiam vivarum gratiae aquarum excipit, easque per suos canales aliis distribuit secundum uniuscujusque meritum & capacitatem. Quod suo calculo confirmat Osorius Jesuita, dicens omne bonum nostrum a Virgine pendere. Et filium, ut mater honoretur, omnem dispensationem gratiae ei commisisse. Quinimo decernit Salazar reliquos omnes Sanctos nihil posse, nihilque boni ab eis defluere, nisi Virgine ceu luna intercedente, atque illorum influxus moderante.
pass_a_gloss: Therefore that Bernardinus de Bustis often named says that God made the Virgin His Cellarer: because God so loved her that He willed us to have nothing which would not pass through her hands. Whence it is that Alexis de Salo says that the Virgin Mary is the neck, through which our savior who is the head pours into the Church every spiritual motion and sense; that she is the trunk through which the root supplies life to the branches and produces flowers, fruits, and leaves. And a basin which receives the abundance of living waters of grace and distributes them through its channels to others according to each one’s merit and capacity. Which Osorius the Jesuit confirms with his vote, saying that every good of ours depends on the Virgin. And that the son, that the mother may be honored, committed to her every dispensation of grace. Nay Salazar decrees that all the other Saints can do nothing, and that no good flows from them, unless the Virgin as moon intervening also moderates their influx.
pass_b_english: Bustis: God made Mary His cellarer—nothing reaches us but by her hands.
Alexis: she is the Church’s neck and grace-basin; Osorius: every good hangs on her.
Salazar: other Saints’ help only through Mary as mediating moon.

lemmas.gloss: with the Virgin intervening as the moon
